method: Read-only visual inspection of actual current-candidate emulator PNGs, supported by matching passed native reports; no emulator actions by this reviewer.

reviewedImages.observation: Normal WARZONE TOWERS heading and subtitle; official artwork; both map options and footer settings are readable, with no TEST, Lab badges, slogans or garbled punctuation.
Compact BUILD catalogue visible; two actual constructor models show native white brackets and green bars. Panel labels and bottom Exit button are not clipped.
The same two actual constructors show native selection highlights after TRUCKS; battlefield and compact footer remain visible.
Power Module card selected and target model green. Immediate panel still shows the preceding 0-pending/2-done frame; this image does not establish the accepted queue count.
Completed four-pillar Power Generator model and two highlighted real constructors are visible. Native module count/build points are corroborated by the matching native report.
After worker travel, repeated BUILD shows two highlighted constructors and the compact module catalogue. Settled construction footer shows 0 pending and 3 done.
Duplicate target capture is distinct from the accepted image. It shows the existing generator preview, not readable rejection text; the native reply is the module-limit evidence.
Both completed research-building models and real highlighted constructors are visible; the matching native report establishes one completed module on each parent.
Post-load battlefield contains the upgraded generator, completed ordinary tower and highlighted constructors with the normal compact footer restored.
Prepared ordinary battlefield visibly contains a combat tank and three constructors, before constructor-only selection.
BUILD catalogue and Guard Tower choice visible immediately; native highlights appear on the three constructors and not on the nearby tank.
Three real constructors show highlights during ongoing work, with visible blue build beams and two numbered accepted ghost sites. Native report proves continuing jobs.
After movement and STOP, all three constructors show native highlights away from their original column; the settled panel lists both towers COMPLETE.
Direct Stats-to-BUILD return shows the compact catalogue and three actual selected constructors, with both completed towers listed.
Factory page is readable with facility selection, saved-design entries, production controls and its Battle return control visible. Existing saved design names are retained private library content.
Factory return restores the actual battlefield and highlighted constructors; no stale Factory overlay remains.
At 2400x1080 the compact catalogue, Exit button, full open field controls, three constructor highlights and minimap are visible without clipping.
At compact 854-wide landscape with enlarged font/control settings, labels, both catalogue columns, footer Exit control, three highlights and minimap remain visible without overlap.
Actual Factory page is readable while native simulation is paused; saved entries, controls and Battle return remain visible.
After Factory Back, actual native PAUSED menu is visible with the underlying field and three native constructor highlights; no stale Factory overlay remains.
Actual resumed field shows three selected constructors, normal compact footer and no pause or Factory overlay.
Final second-round Stats return shows the resumed field with the same three highlights, normal header/footer and no native Stats or pause menu.
Actual Android keyboard is visibly open over Design; name input remains visible above it.
After the second keyboard Back, keyboard is gone and Design remains readable with the name field, Save Changes, Save As New and Blueprint Library controls.
Actual native Quit confirmation is visible over the paused battlefield, with Confirm and Back.
Neutral WARZONE TOWERS / BATTLE ENDED screen has no battle HUD, old field, defeat text or stock frontend menu.
Returned own start screen uses WARZONE TOWERS and official artwork, with normal map choices; the music readiness check is transient before the subsequent successful new launch.
Fresh battle opens its ordinary Orders page with Battle return and View Build Sites controls; no stale prior construction is listed.
Fresh battle after Queue/Back and native Resume shows actual new field models, normal header, compact footer and radar without old pause/queue overlays.

limits: Passed applies to the images and visual checks listed here. All eight native integrated phases also pass in their matching reports; visual paused-return coverage samples Factory and the final Stats return, not every intermediate image.
Immediate captures can precede the settled compositor frame; actual accepted native orders and completed native structures determine construction success.
QuickSave banners in native F7 witness captures belong to the QA save operation.
Software-emulator black terrain is present. No physical-device GPU, audio/FPS, optional-download or full 30-wave victory claim.
Current Quit run began with zero ghost sites. It does not visually or natively prove clearing nonempty sites; historical Test 02 evidence remains historical.
